title: Fire shuts crude unit at large Texas Gulf Coast refinery
text_for_analysis:
[businesswire_energy | tier 1] Fire shuts crude unit at large Texas Gulf Coast refinery
The operator confirmed a fire at its 580,000 barrel-per-day refinery late Sunday. One crude distillation unit is offline with no restart date. No injuries were reported. Gulf Coast gasoline cracks widened in early trading.
